name: Pork Sausage Burger with Roasted Pepper, Mozzarella, Pesto & Coleslaw

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, form the pork sausage into 6 equal-sized patties and place on a plate. Season the top side with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg ground pork sausage
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, working in batches if necessary, add patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain roasted peppers. Thinly slice cheese.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (340 g) jars roasted red bell peppers
¾ (227 g) block mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: When the patties are done on one side, flip, then top with cheese and roasted peppers. Continue to grill until sausage is cooked through, 5-7 minutes more. Transfer to a clean plate.
While the patties are cooking, place shredded cabbage in a large bowl. Drizzle with dressing, sprinkle with spices, then stir until well combined. Set slaw aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (397 g) bags shredded cabbage (coleslaw mix)
⅓ cup ranch dressing
3 pinch garlic powder
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Spread pesto on the bottom half of each bun, then top with cheesy patties. Close with the top half of each bun.
To serve, divide burgers and slaw between plates. Enjoy!
